title: NexusPlay SMP

body:
Wait! Give us a chance you dont really need to read all of this but

this server is dying! And we need more people so it could feel alove again! We have custom terrain generation, and custom stuff, also you dont even need to anything else to join the server just put the ip (or also port) then accept the resource pack download and your done!
